(2020): NOAA 0.25-degree Daily Optimum Interpolation Sea Surface Temperature (OISST), Version 2.1. NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information. https://doi.org/10.25921/RE9P-PT57. Accessed 2026-10-30.
files.note: NOAA/NCEI 1/4-degree Daily Optimum Interpolation SST v2.1 (AVHRR-only, 'Final'), NOAA Level 4 analysis for 2024-09-01. Optimum interpolation of AVHRR satellite SST (MetOp-A/B) blended with ship, buoy and Argo in-situ SST; sea-ice concentration converted to proxy SST at the ice margin. Global 0.25-degree grid (1440 x 720, lat -90..90, lon 0..360), one time step, one zlev. Variables (all Celsius except ice in %): sst (daily SST), anom (daily SST anomaly), err (estimated error std-dev), ice (sea-ice concentration). Product record from 1981-09-01 to present; v2.1 replaced v2 in April 2020.

files.note: CMS Monte Carlo simulation (not collision data) of Standard Model Higgs (m=125 GeV) -> ZZ -> 4 leptons in 8 TeV pp collisions, derived from /SMHiggsToZZTo4L_M-125_8TeV-powheg15-JHUgenV3-pythia6/Summer12_DR53X-PU_S10_START53_V19-v1/AODSIM (CERN Open Data record 9356, CMS 2012 conditions). Reduced to a flat NanoAOD-like ntuple with 299,973 events; 32 branches: run/luminosityBlock/event, primary vertex (PV_npvs, PV_x/y/z), muons and electrons (pt, eta, phi, mass, charge, isolation, dxy, dz + errors), MET_pt/phi. Intended for the H->4l outreach analysis (record 12360).

files.processing: TRIMMED: first 10 MiB fetched by HTTP Range from the 684 MB original, decompressed, complete 899-line header kept plus the first 3,323 complete records (21:9,825,785-10,942,691), last partial record dropped, re-compressed with bgzip (validated with tabix). sha256 is of the trimmed file, not the original.
files.note: Genome Aggregation Database (gnomAD) v2.1.1 exome sites VCF for chromosome 21, GRCh37. Aggregate allele-frequency summary statistics from 125,748 exomes (no individual genotypes or sample IDs). Variants called with GATK HaplotypeCaller, QC'd with Hail; random-forest filter (FILTER: PASS/RF/AC0/InbreedingCoeff). INFO (~869 fields): AC/AN/AF overall and by ancestry group and sex, nhomalt, subset frequencies (non_cancer, non_neuro, non_topmed, controls), site QC metrics (QD, MQ, FS, SOR, DP...), and Ensembl VEP consequence annotations (vep field incl. LoFTEE).

files.note: UK Department for Transport road traffic statistics: Annual Average Daily Flow (AADF) by count point for the Wales region (region_id 4, ONS W92000004), years 2000-2025, 37,338 rows x 31 columns. Columns: count_point_id, year, region/local authority ids and names, road_name, road_type (major/minor), start/end junction, easting/northing, latitude/longitude, link length (km/miles), estimation_method ('Counted' vs 'Estimated') and detail, and AADF by vehicle class (pedal_cycles, two-wheeled motor vehicles, cars_and_taxis, buses_and_coaches, lgvs, 6 HGV axle classes, all_hgvs, all_motor_vehicles). DfT note: regional/national figures are accredited official statistics; link-level estimates are less robust.
